description: Matches a bank statement CSV to an invoice CSV using exact arithmetic, and sorts every line into matched, likely, review or unmatched. Use for bank reconciliation, finding who has paid, or finding payments with no invoice. Read-only, and never uses the network. Results include names and amounts from the files, so they reach the model. Report review items to the user instead of deciding them.

bank_columns.description: Column names, when detection fails, such as {"date":"Posted","amount":"Value"}

bank_path.description: Path to the bank statement CSV

date_format.description: Needed only if the tool reports that dates are ambiguous

invoice_columns.description: Column names, when detection fails, such as {"number":"Doc","amount":"Gross"}

invoices_path.description: Path to the invoice or bill CSV

limit.description: Most items per group. 0 returns only the summary

mode.description: receivable matches money in to customer invoices; payable matches money out to bills

window_days.description: How long after the invoice date a payment can count, for matches without an invoice number

name: reconcile_match
title: Match bank lines to invoices
